time_convention: t = frame / 30; frame 0 at t = 0; time t -> frame round(30 t)
units: pixels (full 3840x2160 image coords, x right, y down) and seconds; no metric scale
description: Side view of a person (beige cap, white long-sleeve top, khaki trousers, light shoes, face blurred) riding a black two-wheel electric kick scooter from right to left along a light paved path in front of hedges and a wooden pergola with four benches; a green sports court with a white centre circle and centre line is in the foreground; a beige multi-storey building and trees in the background. The rider is in view and moving the whole clip.

camera.type: nearly static handheld/tripod with slow drift (small pan + roll)
camera.background_shift_px: background at the rider's depth moves +31 px in x (to the right) and +6 (x=1300) to +16 (x=2900) px in y from frame 0 to 93, smoothly (~0.34 px/frame in x); roll ~0.36 deg; scale change < 0.1 %
camera.per_frame_file: camera_affine.csv (affine frame0 -> frame i; 'band' = fit on hedges/benches at rider depth, 'top' = building)
camera.effect: rider moves ~16.6 px/frame leftward; the pan adds ~+0.34 px/frame (about 2 %). Stabilised coordinates (*_stab columns, in frame-0 pixel coords) remove it; raw image coords are also given.

perspective: Effectively 2D side view: rider moves parallel to the image plane, but drifts slightly toward the camera: ground-contact y goes 1122.5 -> 1137 and apparent scooter length 181 -> 193.5 px (~ +6 %) from frame 0 to 93. Court markings in the foreground are strongly foreshortened (circle 1353 px wide x 228 px tall) and lie at a different (nearer) depth than the rider.

objects.name: rider_scooter
objects.parts: rider (person) + black e-scooter they stand on; tracked as one object
objects.distinguish: the only moving object; white top, beige cap, khaki trousers; scooter black with grey spoked rear wheel
objects.direction: right to left (-x) the whole clip, nearly constant pixel velocity
objects.reference_point: cx,cy = centre of the bounding box of rider+scooter (front tyre front edge .. rear tyre rear edge, cap top .. lowest tyre bottom). Alternatives in the file: front/rear wheel axle centres, torso point (upper chest), all also camera-stabilised.

sizes_px.person_height_cap_top_to_shoe_sole_on_de: about 279 px at frame 0 (818 -> ~1097) and about 292 px at frame 93 (819 -> ~1111); manual, +-4 px
